objective: Map how Film Grunge and Film Damage scratch/dust controls quantize into mark counts across practical render sizes, and compare how much mark count changes for 0.01 control adjustments.

scope.effects: Only the C++ source count expressions for Film Grunge scratchAmount/dustAmount and Film Damage scratches/dust. Use their actual documented/default control ranges and defaults. No random placement or mark rendering.
scope.method: Offline Python Float32 arithmetic model of source count formulas, scanning controls 0..1 at 0.01 increments and calculating source-derived counts at 512x256, 1024x512, 1920x1080 and 3840x2160. Derive ideal control step intervals from the integer count scale and compare to Float32 scan.
excluded: mark geometry, opacity, masks or rendered pixels

comparison.baseline: Count at control=0 and source default control; count formula itself is the measured quantity, not a pixel baseline.
candidates: Film Grunge scratch/dust controls, each independently
Film Damage scratch/dust controls, each independently
four fixed image sizes and 101 slider values [0,.01,...,1]
comparison.ground_truth: No visual target. Source code count expression is the only expected reference.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive count mapping only. Require exact source marker agreement, control=0 -> count=0, nondecreasing counts, and agreement of scanned transition counts with declared arithmetic. Do not infer visual density, perceived strength, or equivalence.

materials.fixture: No image pixels. Analytic dimensions from 512x256 to 3840x2160; normalized area and width are derived from exact integer sizes.
materials.identity: Hash exact source files, plan, runner; record formulas, dimensions, controls and all count outputs.

conditions.numeric_domain: Controls converted to Float32; positive counts truncate toward zero as in static_cast<int>. For Film Grunge, width/18 and width*height/900 are integer divisions before multiplication. For Film Damage, dust multiplies Float32 in source expression order then divides by 180.0f.
conditions.equation: Grunge scratches=int(f*max(1,width//18)); Grunge dust=int(f*max(1,(width*height)//900)); Damage scratches=int(f*18); Damage dust=int(f*width*height/180.0f), with each multiply/divide rounded to Float32 in source order. f ranges [0,1].
conditions.regions_and_rois: No pixel masks. Every control/resolution/component tuple is a distinct analytic condition.
metrics: number/fraction of slider steps with zero count change
ideal control interval between count thresholds
count threshold alignment against float32 scanner
conditions.display: Labeled control-response plots show mark counts and changes per .01; they visualize formulas, not rendered marks.

effect_correctness.method: Source markers, exact arithmetic expression order, zero and monotonic invariants, count grid output.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: All counts match the declared Float32/integer equations; no output-image claim.

image_quality_and_detail.reason: No image marks are placed or rendered. Morphology work remains separate.

color_and_alpha.reason: Count-only model has no pixel/color/alpha values.

temporal_stability.reason: No RNG or frame keys are evaluated.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Actual runtime counts/placement and preview/final dimensions.

evaluation.decision: No parameter recommendation, visual-strength equivalence or implementation approval.

execution.backend: Python NumPy Float32 calculations and Pillow chart output; no C++, app or GUI.
execution.threshold_policy: No perceptual thresholds; count transitions are exact source-equation results.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed source files, size grid, Float32 control grid and hashes.
